moat.evidence: 90%+ of pharma intermediates integrated to basic chemicals; 50-90% global share in key intermediates (trazodone, dolutegravir, entacapone, pazopanib); gross margin 46-47% even before CDMO; 26 process patents filed

moat.factor: Regulatory lock-in on the darolutamide CDMO contract
moat.evidence: 10-year supply agreement (CY22) with Fermion; intermediates filed in the innovator's dossiers; patent protection to 2033 (US, Japan) and 2035 (major EU)
CDMO was ~47% of FY26 revenue (Rs635 cr, PL) and mostly one molecule for one customer; it explains almost all of the margin step-up from 23% to 36%
~1,100 KL of reactors and Rs1,339 cr of revenue: a niche leader, far smaller than Divi's or Laurus; Sachin is full and Ankleshwar fills by ~FY28
Battery additives started in Q1FY27 at ~15% target margins against Chinese incumbents; BFC has shrunk from Rs51 cr to Rs16 cr on one customer; Indichem has no revenue until FY28
USFDA EIRs, PMDA GMP, EcoVadis Platinum; no warning letter found; but most legacy products are generic intermediates sold on price

critiques: Concentration: CDMO (mostly darolutamide intermediates for one customer) was ~47% of FY26 revenue and the source of the margin jump; Kotak Institutional Equities downgraded to Reduce on exactly this (27-Jul-2026).
Patent clock: Nubeqa's key patents run to 2033 in the US and 2035 in Europe (UK 2029); generic darolutamide would end the premium economics of the anchor contract within ~7-9 years.
The base business is not growing: pharma intermediates excluding CDMO were Rs511 cr (FY24), Rs572 cr (FY25) and Rs539 cr (FY26) as low-margin products were dropped.
New engines are early and lower-margin: battery additives target ~15% EBITDA at full use and compete with Chinese suppliers; Indichem starts revenue only in FY28; BFC has shrunk for three years.
Other income flatters FY26: Rs32.5 cr of forex gains (6.7% of PBT) fell to Rs0.1 cr in Q1FY27; the street (PL Rs53 cr FY27E) still models high other income.
Valuation: ~75x trailing and ~60x one-year-forward on the street's FY27E vs HSIE's ~41x five-year average; the stock rose ~2.6x in the twelve months to Sep-2026.
Promoter selling and value transfer: the two promoters sold 3.3% in Jun-2025; the Korean partner received 25% of Indichem for no cash (Rs47.5 cr of goodwill).
gaps: Customer concentration is not disclosed in the AR (no customers-above-10% note); the darolutamide/Fermion share of revenue is inferred from PL's CDMO series (company data) and Kotak's comment, not disclosed by the company
CDMO revenue FY24-26 (Rs57/282/635 cr) comes from PL's initiation (Exhibit 21, 'Company, PL'); the company does not split CDMO and non-CDMO publicly ('we are not giving any split', Q1FY27 call)
Battery additive prices, contracted volumes and customer names are not disclosed; our battery revenue path is our estimate
Segment EBITDA is not audited (single segment in the AR); quarterly segment margins come from CFO remarks (Q4FY26 pharma 44% / specialty 29%; Q1FY27 36% / 24%)
